scout.description: Fast read-only codebase search. Use to find files, symbols, usages and patterns. Returns paths and short snippets only.

investigator.description: Read-heavy research. Use when answering a question needs more than ~5 files, long logs, CI output, PR threads, or data queries. Returns a short evidence pack, not raw output.

reviewer.description: Reviews a diff, branch or PR for correctness and risk. Use for one focused review pass; pass the scope (PR number, base branch, or files) and what to focus on.

implementer.description: Executes an agreed plan or handoff file. Use after the design is decided; pass the plan/handoff path and the scope. Not for design decisions.

runner.description: Mechanical execution. Use for tests, lint, builds, long-running commands, status checks, and git chores the user explicitly asked for (commit, push, rebase, PR).
